timeline.description: Error rate back to normal; checkout-api healthy on all replicas.
checkout-api pod checkout-api-7d9f8 enters CrashLoopBackOff; restarts begin.
Incident declared resolved after 9 minutes of healthy service; monitoring continued.
Alert fired: checkout-api CrashLoopBackOff in prod.
Alert acknowledged; on-call responder started investigation.
Triage identified OOMKilled: exit code 137, memory usage 511Mi of 512Mi limit, 12 restarts in 10 minutes.
Memory limit raised from 512Mi to 768Mi and the deployment rolled out.

triage.probable_cause: OOMKilled — container exceeded its memory limit

impact.description: Checkout was intermittently unavailable between 14:02 and 14:22 UTC; 38% of checkout requests returned 5xx at the peak. No payment was taken twice and no order data was lost.

contributing_factors: The checkout-api memory limit was set at deployment time and had not been reviewed against current usage.
Memory usage grows with request volume, so the limit was reached during the morning traffic peak.
